segments.title: Chương 282: 0283【Quyết định của Biên Quan Nguyệt】
segments.content:
Chapter 286 0283 Bian Guanyue's Choice

Early November.

The "Original Music Online Competition," jointly hosted by Xiami Music, Xiaonei Wang, and Hainei Wang, came to a close.

The competition process was a bit complicated.

This was because the votes from the veteran users of Xiami Music, the users of Xiaonei Wang, and the users of Hainei Wang, as well as the scores from professional musicians, showed significant divergence and differences.

The user groups from all major platforms started a commotion, engaging in flame wars in the competition's comment section every day.

There was no other choice but to create three separate ranking lists, which were then combined with the music critics' scores to produce the final rankings.

Over the weekend, Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue came over again.

This time they didn't bicker, as if they had gotten used to each other's presence, and listened to music with Chen Guiliang with great interest.

"The winning song voted by Xiaonei Wang is so cool!" Tao Xue liked it as soon as she heard it.

Bian Guanyue surprisingly agreed, "I don't usually like rap, but this rap song is particularly interesting."

Chen Guiliang felt the same way.

The three of them found their standards for music appreciation unified by this song.

The song was titled "Binary Love Letter."

The artists were the Shuimu Xing duo from Tsinghua University, one called Shuixing and the other Muxing. Both were master's students in computer science.

The song began with a rapid drumbeat, accompanied by the Windows XP startup sound and the dialing sound of an old-school modem.

Immediately after, a male voice rhythmically recited binary code.

"01100110, 01110010, 01101111, 01101101." (Meaning "from")

The rap voice suddenly intensified:

"My love is burned as tracks on an old floppy disk,

Filling up 1.44MB, yet I don't dare to write-protect it.

while(meet_you == true) my heart overflowed its stack at the Second School Gate,

Compiling the entire autumn, just for your single word: Passed."

Even though these four lines of lyrics didn't rhyme, they just had a certain feel and flavor when sung.

Then it continued:

"I'm like an exception instruction stuck in a try-catch,

When your gaze scans past my void core.

Packaging this inexplicable longing into a static class,

But losing all courage at link time. Courage, courage, I've lost my courage."

Then it began to recall the process of a secret crush, accompanied by various life scenes like "Lanqiying Internet Cafe" and "the last bus at Wudaokou."

The final verse was even crazier:

"This love letter, written with residual cache,啊 has been transmitting for half a century through the shriek of a dial-up modem, system("format C:/love") // Formatting my life for you. my_heart.BlueScreen() // My heart blue screens from a broken heart..."

The comment section was absolutely buzzing. There were even computer science students pointing out the syntax error in the DOS format command.

The artist personally came out to explain: "I made the mistake on purpose. This is love's violent modification of computer language. Love has tampered with the source code of life."

There were also students from non-computer science majors asking what the various codes and instructions meant, and a large number of knowledgeable students came out to help explain.

But this song was destined to be niche; it only ranked first on the Xiaonei Wang user voting list. In the Xiami Music voting, it barely made it into the top ten, and in the Hainei Wang voting, it ranked beyond thirtieth place.

And the winning song chosen by Hainei Wang users was actually a song written by Xu Song specifically for this competition.

The song's title was "A Thousand Mountains Apart from the Moon," which had never appeared in the other world. It had obvious traces of imitating Jay Chou, but it was written with Xu Song's own style.

Bian Guanyue commented, "I don't really like this 'A Thousand Mountains Apart from the Moon.' The imitation is too heavy."

Chen Guiliang smiled and said, "That's why it was voted to the top spot by Hainei Wang users. And the veteran users of Xiami Music also voted this song into the top ten. Everyone still really likes Jay Chou."

It reached the major music platforms. In just a few days, the number of downloads on several music websites soared. This song should be confirmed as one of the main ringtones we promote next."

Chen Guiliang said, "Alright, you make the call. What about the download count for 'Binary Love Letter'?"

Huang Xinyuan said, "There's a lot of discussion about that song, but its download count is less than one-third of 'A Thousand Mountains Apart from the Moon'."

"There's also another song, 'My Love Will Never Regret.' It's a very old-fashioned, melodramatic tearjerker. During the netizen voting, it didn't even make the top twenty on any of the three lists. But its online download count is second only to 'A Thousand Mountains Apart from the Moon,' currently ranking second. Based on my experience with ringtones, once this song is promoted, its ringtone downloads will probably far exceed 'A Thousand Mountains Apart from the Moon'."

Professionals view things from a different perspective.

Huang Xinyuan had been working with ringtones for two or three years. He knew that a large portion of ringtone users would never participate in this kind of voting. And these people happened to be the main force behind ringtone downloads!

If "Two Butterflies" had been entered into the competition, it probably wouldn't have even made the top fifty, but its ringtones sold extremely well.

Chen Guiliang had a discussion with Huang Xinyuan and then called Wang Hao, the CEO of Xiami Music.

Wang Hao sounded half-worried, half-pleased, "The month-long Original Music Online Competition has brought more than 200,000 new registered users to Xiami Music. But the composition of these new users is too mixed. The 100,000 veteran users from before have quite a few complaints, feeling that Xiami Music has been tainted. Alas, I'm trying to mediate the situation, mainly relying on separate ranking lists to keep the peace."

Chen Guiliang said, "Figure it out yourself. Try your best to retain both the new and old users."

This "have your cake and eat it too" attitude left Wang Hao a bit speechless.

Xiami Music was a subsidiary in which Bytedance held a controlling stake. It had to develop quickly to present an excellent report card before the IPO.

After handling business matters, Chen Guiliang continued to listen to music with them.

Although he didn't have an arm around each of them, one sat to his left and the other to his right. Both girls sat very close, staring at the computer screen together.

"Let's listen to that one, 'Boiling Chrysanthemums by the Autumn Fence.' You can tell it's Chinese-style just from the name," Tao Xue said, pointing to a song on the list.

They finished listening after three or four minutes.

Bian Guanyue commented, "The imitation is very crude, far worse than that song by Xu Song."

Bian Guanyue was usually quite tactful, but she became sharp-tongued when it came to music.

They were currently in the new house that Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue had bought.

Bian Guanyue had deliberately revealed it, and Chen Guiliang couldn't stop her...

When Tao Xue heard the news, her expression was clearly downcast, but she still accepted the invitation to visit the new house.

As noon approached, Bian Guanyue stood up and said, "I'll go cook for you guys."

Tao Xue pouted.

Bian Guanyue was playing the role of the hostess again.

When sounds came from the kitchen, Tao Xue said to Chen Guiliang, "When I make money in the future, I'm going to buy a house too... Mm, purely for investment. Xuezhang, do you want to partner up?"

Chen Guiliang agreed without hesitation, "Sure."

Only then did Tao Xue cheer up, skipping into the kitchen, "Xuejie, let me help you cook!"

"No need, I can manage on my own."

"Then I'll help you wash the vegetables. Where's the potato peeler?"

"Let me look for it, I think I bought one..."

Both of these girls were half-decent at cooking, at best their food could be considered passable.

But now they were competing to show off.

Listening to the sounds from the kitchen, Chen Guiliang fantasized about that Chinese idiom: "A man of Qi had a wife and a concubine..."

Bah, I'm nothing like that man of Qi who went around begging!

Chen Guiliang took out his language repeater and started studying English again. His English level was improving rapidly now, especially his listening and speaking skills.

Although he had been diligent in his third year of high school, he had too many subjects to catch up on back then and could only allocate a portion of his time to English.

Now, he was practicing whenever he wasn't working. It would be unacceptable if he didn't make rapid progress.

"Xuezhang, come out and eat!" Tao Xue called from the living room.

Chen Guiliang took off his headphones and walked to the dining room, only to see the two girls both wearing aprons, looking like gentle and capable housewives.

If they could always get along this harmoniously, Chen Guiliang would be willing to accept mediocre-tasting meals.

"I learned how to make this tomato braised beef this summer," Bian Guanyue grandly introduced the main dish she had made.

Tao Xue quickly said, "I made this hot and sour shredded potato and scrambled eggs with tomato."

Chen Guiliang tasted every dish and, against his conscience, gave a thumbs-up, "So delicious! This beef is stewed so tender and soft, and the flavor of the tomato is simply a perfect match... Mm, this hot and sour shredded potato is not bad either. It's very rare to cook such a common dish to this level..."

The two girls were so praised by him that they believed it was true, and hurriedly went to get a taste of the dishes they had made themselves.
